title: Make concurrency tests load resilient
body:
Replace time-based waits with condition waits bounded by deadlines in Product `test/verdict/sandbox.test.ts` SIGTERM/SIGINT verdict tests, `test/hosts/codex-registration.test.ts` registration and `onStarted` gates, `test/flow/review-parallel.test.ts`, and `test/live-smoke-signal.test.ts`; give `test/task/claims.test.ts` and `test/task/task.test.ts` private temporary roots, and make the `claim --next` race test assert invariants instead of an exact winner count. The GLOBAL `test/host-lock.test.mjs` part moved to its own task.
Acceptance: each test waits for its required condition, uses no fixed sleep or elapsed-time assertion, writes only under its own temporary root, and passes under concurrent load.
